behavior.disabled: Use native disabled and never fire the action.

loading.label: Use an operation-specific progressive label such as 保存中 or 正在提交.

behavior.failure: Return to an actionable state; communicate the error with Toast, field error or page message rather than a persistent Button error state.
behavior.focus: Provide a visible :focus-visible ring without changing layout size. Not a Figma State and not a spec showcase state. No Prototype Reaction.
behavior.pressedMotion: Scale to 0.98 while actively pressed; never translate vertically.
behavior.iconOnly: Require an accessible name. Use only when the operation meaning is clear. Square hit area 40/32/24. padding-block 0 via Interval/space1. Do not mix with gj-icon-button. Text Button has no icon-only.

content.overflowRule: Shorten the action label; do not wrap to two lines.

mixing button heights with an adjacent primary control

openItems.iconTextGap: The existing extraction confirms that spacing is variable-bound but does not preserve its per-size values. Do not create a global Button icon-gap token until the Figma component is read again.

textButton.definition: A padding-free lightweight text action for navigation, view-more and filter triggers, including placements where a regular button height would disturb the container layout.

behavior.disabled: Use native disabled and never fire the action.
behavior.focus: Provide focus-visible without changing the component layout size.
behavior.pressedMotion: Scale to 0.98 while actively pressed; never translate vertically.
behavior.hitArea: Expand the pointer target with an outer wrapper or pseudo-element when necessary; never add visible padding or change the line-box height.
behavior.prototypeReaction: Not required in Figma. Implement hover, pressed and disabled from the state contract in code; absence of Prototype Reaction is not an absent-state signal.

content.overflowRule: Shorten the action label; do not wrap to two lines.
